entities.summary: Senty Church is a Christian church built in 965 in the territory of modern Karachay-Cherkessia. It is situated on the left bank of the Teberda River, near the village of Nizhnyaya Teberda, 18 km south of Karachaevsk. Senty Church is the earliest dated church in Russia.
